_marker: CHILD-WIDER-THAN-PARENT BASELINE — a committed per-library defect count that may only DECREASE. `overflows` counts in-flow children wider than their parent with a non-text cause; `textCaused` counts the exempted class (the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap, docs/22) separately so it can never flatter the first number. Both ratchet TWO-SIDED: an increase is a new defect, a decrease is a fix that must be re-recorded here with its cause named. Re-record deliberately with `node scripts/child-wider.mjs --write` and say what moved.

rows.cause: overflows(5): ProgressBar `fill` renders 100px inside a 48px `track` in all five Variant cells — ONE defect class, a PERCENT width (`width: 100%`) baked as a px literal by the computed floor. textCaused(6): the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap (docs/22 §"Text wrapping is not implemented") — Figma text nodes auto-size on one line, so a hugging box holds an unwrapped run.

textCaused(8): all eight are the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap in Accordion (docs/22). Carbon's NON-text overflows were closed by the live-defect round (9c30204, D3) and its own compile receipt keeps a HARD zero on them — this row is the exempted class only.

overflows(2): Wave 5 denominator — `label` paints 75px inside a 74px Size=Medium/Small hug cell (Size=Medium + Size=Small). textCaused(14): corpus-wide text-wrapping gap (docs/22) — AccordionDetails body remains the canonical case; Wave 5 carried Alert/TextField/… added eight more exempted text overflows. marginBox(2): Autocomplete POPUP indicator margin-right -2 (unchanged from task-#38).

marginBox(42): every one of the 42 the Carbon round published as "polaris 42" is a NEGATIVE-MARGIN paint-outside, not an overflow. The margin-box wrapper reserves less layout space than its child paints, which is what a negative margin is for. Polaris has ZERO real child-wider overflows. Correcting the published number is the first thing this instrument did when it ran repo-wide. textCaused(29): NEW at the task-#26 recapture (2026-07-29) — the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap (docs/22 §"Text wrapping is not implemented") was ALWAYS in the library, but polaris's round-5-era artifacts predated the instrument's text-caused detection, so its exempted class read 0 by staleness, not by absence. The first fresh capture in the modern engine surfaces the same class every other text-bearing library already records (astryx 6, carbon 8, mui 6); the wrapping fix remains its own corpus-wide round. Real child-wider overflows stay at ZERO.
